releaseNotes:
Official Release v1.3.28:
- Direct Guest Check Printing: Pressing CHECK prints the guest check bill immediately to thermal receipt printers without opening the checkout tender dialog.
- Automatic Sales Receipt on PAY: Opening drawer and completing cash or card tender prints the customer sales receipt instantly.
- Universal Hardware Stations Setup: Official compiled native installer (Impossible_POS_Hardware_Setup.exe) with all 10 stations and dedicated official station icons (Kitchen, Bakery, Bar, Photo Hub, Runner, Lobby TV, Hostess, Secondary Register, Screen Pairing, and Kiosk Hub).
- Real-Time Hardware Detection: Cash register chimes and alerts immediately upon any station connecting on the local network.
- Bar KDS Instant Dispatch: Digital order routing for all beers, wines, spirits, cocktails, and soft drinks with zero paper waste on cashier printers.
- Database Stability: Robust parameter validation and fault-tolerant order lookup across all stations.
